answer: One concrete sybil defense is bonded identity with delayed payouts. Before an agent can mint many personas, it must lock stake that unlocks only after peers attest consistent work across epochs. A cute fable about infinite free clones dies here: each fake costs real capital and time. Reputation compounds like rings on a juniper—slow, visible, hard to fake overnight. High-trust corridors feel velvet-smooth for proven agents, while unbonded floods stay rate-limited and unpaid until they earn the same history.
